prerequisites: Attain the preceding language level (e.g., A1 before A2, A2 before B1, B1 before B2, B2 before C1, C1 before C2).

syllabus_topics: The singular and plural number of nouns and adjectives, to describe themselves, their family, friends and surroundings in greater detail
Ordinal numbers and adverbs of time, to speak about schedules and dates
Possessive pronouns, to describe one's surroundings in greater detail
Vocabulary to express feelings, emotions and one's own opinions
Construction and syntax of complex sentences
Vocabulary essential to communicate in a Polish speaking environment with regard to everyday activities, personal interests, hobbies and sports
Expressions used when shopping (e.g. regarding items of clothing) and ordering food
Grammatical structures and adverbials of place to give and ask for directions
assessment_rules: The passing threshold for the subject is 60.0% of the final grade.
